day_shape: CENTCOM announces fresh wave of strikes on Iran targeting Strait of Hormuz military capabilities, Trump threatens power plants and bridges next week, IDF kills three Hamas commanders in Gaza, Iran extends UK detainee Craig Foreman's sentence by two years.

threads.label: US strikes and escalation threats
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it launched a wave of strikes on Iran at 6am ET to degrade capabilities used against Strait of Hormuz shipping, while Trump warned power plants and bridges could be hit next week. A senior Iranian cleric said infrastructure threats were no reason to keep talking, and IRIB cited NBC estimating war costs could reach $100 billion.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and Iran-linked espionage
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hussam al-Shafie, who took part in the October 7 abduction of Col. Asaf Hamami and two soldiers, along with Nukhba commanders Ali Shamlakh and Nasser Louh in northern Gaza. A military court sentenced an IDF conscript to five years for spying for Iran in 2025, and Lebanese media reported the arrest in Beirut of an alleged high-level Israeli agent.

threads.label: UK detainee and Iranian missile fallout in Israel
threads.summary: The family of British national Craig Foreman said Iran added two years to his 10-year sentence, alleging he was denied a lawyer and translator. In Haifa, 82-year-old Michael Katz died of wounds sustained in an April Iranian ballistic missile strike, and Israel suspended flights to the UAE with US tankers parked at Ben-Gurion.

threads.label: Tehran wartime posture and readiness messaging
threads.summary: The Guardian Council approved a mechanism allowing virtual parliament sessions in emergency conditions, and Defa Press quoted foreign ministry spokesman Bagheri saying Iran is ready for any scenario. Speaker Qalibaf was billed to release an explanatory statement on the war, and former FM Mottaki reportedly called for seizing a US base and taking troops hostage.

threads.label: Araghchi in Doha
threads.summary: Iranian state and IRGC-affiliated outlets reported Foreign Minister Araghchi travelled to Doha to attend a ceremony honouring former Qatari Emir Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. The trip was reported repeatedly across IRIB and Defa Press through the day.

events.title_en: Bagheri: Iran is prepared for any scenario/ 'Commitment for commitment' is our principle in agreements
events.summary_en: Bagheri: Iran is prepared for any scenario/ 'Commitment for commitment' is our principle in agreements. Ismail Bagheri, spokesman for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in an interview with Defapress' international correspondent, regarding the Islamic Republic of Iran's readiness to respond to any hostile action, stated: We are certainly ready and have demonstrated this readiness over the past 47 years and particularly in the last year and a half. The Islamic Republic of Iran has learned well from its previous experiences. We, with all our capacity and by utilising the capabilities that living in these special circumstances has provided us with, are fully prepared for any eventuality and scenario. This readiness exists both in our armed forces and in the state apparatus.

events.title_en: Denmark purchases two maritime patrol aircraft
events.summary_en: Denmark purchases two maritime patrol aircraft. Denmark confirmed its purchase of two P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft from the United States. Denmark's defence minister announced that these aircraft will play an important role in protecting the country's sovereignty and fulfilling its NATO commitments, particularly in anti-submarine warfare. Previously, the US Defence Security Cooperation Agency had approved the sale of a maximum of three P-8As to Denmark for a value of around 1.8 billion dollars, but Copenhagen has now finalised the purchase of two aircraft.

events.title_en: Measure on 'mechanism for holding parliament sessions in times of emergency' approved by the Guardian Council
events.summary_en: Measure on 'mechanism for holding parliament sessions in times of emergency' approved by the Guardian Council. The Guardian Council spokesman announced the approval of the measure on the 'mechanism for holding parliament sessions in times of emergency' by the Council. In accordance with the provision of the single article of this measure, in times of emergency and special circumstances of the country, which the Presidium of Parliament determines that the presence of representatives and the holding of official sessions of Parliament, including plenary sessions, commissions and the Presidium in the aforementioned venue is not possible, these sessions shall be held by notifying representatives in that venue or other venues other than the permanent venue or in virtual space.

events.title_en: General Rezaei: The measured decisions of the martyred leader guided the country through difficult passages. Commander-in-Chief of the Sepah during the eight-year imposed war said: When future generations flip through the pages of history of this period, they will see how, in one of the most turbulent periods of contemporary history; wise, brave, sharp and farsighted leadership kept the flag of the Revolution unfurled and guided the Iranian nation through difficult passages. Martyr Ayatollah al-Uzma Khamenei was not merely a manager, a politician or a commander; rather, he was the point of support for a nation and indeed the Islamic Ummah in navigating through historical twists. One of the most important dimensions of his character was simultaneous attention to idealism and realism.

events.title_en: Pakistan engulfed in terrorist attacks; 108 killed and 65 wounded. In recent days, following attacks by terrorist groups, the Pakistani government and military have demonstrated a unified resolve to eliminate terrorism and reaffirmed their commitment to intensifying counter-terrorism operations. However, no new initiatives, policies or reforms have been announced by the Pakistani government or military to address the country's deteriorating security situation. Balochistan province is considered the main centre of these attacks, with 25 attacks and 102 deaths recorded in this province. The deterioration of the security situation in Balochistan has been exacerbated by increased activity by the terrorist group 'Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan' in the northern areas of the province.

events.title_en: Possibility of regional war continuing until 2027. Following the escalation of tensions in West Asia, an analysis published on the Haber network reports the possibility of prolonging the confrontation between the United States and Iran until 2027. The process of tensions between Iran and the United States during the regional war could continue until mid-2027 or even the end of 2027, and the United States, accompanied by a coalition of willing partners, may enter new phases of this confrontation. In this analysis, experts, by examining military and political movements, emphasised that this crisis could expand to wider dimensions and could more seriously bring in international players including NATO and the UN Security Council.
